driver_memory.basis: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss at export time — the driver process peak over the whole leg (KiB on Linux)

basis.spool_df: df -kP of the spool path INSIDE the container (the overlay the engine writes to; size/used/avail in KiB as the engine sees them)
basis.spool_du: du -sk + `find -type f | wc -l` of the spool path inside the container — spool in flight at the instant of the read; at leg END (before the tokens are terminated) a non-zero count is a spool LEAK
basis.mounts: /proc/mounts lines for / and the spool path inside the container — a spool path with no mount of its own lives on the writable layer (host fs under the docker root)
basis.cgroup: cgroup v2 memory.current (incl. page cache) / memory.stat anon (OOM-relevant) / file (reclaimable), read inside the container
basis.procs: sum over every /proc/[0-9]*/status in the container of VmRSS, RssAnon, VmData, VmSize (KiB) + n processes; top_by_rss lists the largest with cmdline so the persistent engine server and the per-token processes are separable
basis.layer: docker ps -s SIZE: the writable layer (spool + container logs + anything written), first token; virtual size second
basis.host_df: os.statvfs of each host path: total/free/avail/used bytes; device and fstype from df -P
basis.frag_ext4: /proc/fs/ext4/<dev>/mb_groups summed over block groups: free blocks, free fragments, avg free extent KiB, per-order histogram (count of free extents of 2^k blocks), share of free blocks in extents >= 2^10 blocks (4 MiB; lower bound from the histogram) — e2freefrag's data source
basis.frag_tool: e2freefrag / xfs_spaceman text, best-effort via sudo -n; state recorded
basis.diskstats: /proc/diskstats row for the device: reads, sectors_read, writes, sectors_written, io_ms (cumulative; leg delta = churn volume)
basis.fs_stream: statvfs of the host paths every period_s under the leg: used/avail bytes; summary = start/end/max used, min avail per path
basis.service_memory_trajectory: collector role_tick rows for role=service: first 5 min mean -> last 5 min mean, max, time-quartile means, for rss / vms / cg_anon / cg_current / n_procs

fs_stream.basis: statvfs of the host paths every period_s under the leg: used/avail bytes; summary = start/end/max used, min avail per path

service_memory_trajectory.basis: collector role_tick rows for role=service: first 5 min mean -> last 5 min mean, max, time-quartile means, for rss / vms / cg_anon / cg_current / n_procs
